title: Renewal
text: This rental agreement automatically renews unless the tenant gives 60 days written notice.

title: Unilateral fees
text: Under this agreement the landlord may adjust fees at its sole discretion.
expected: Terms can change without your agreement

title: Indemnity
text: The tenant shall indemnify the landlord for all claims arising from the tenant's use of the property.

title: Arbitration
text: Disputes under this loan agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration.

title: Late fee
text: The borrower must pay a late fee of $50 for an overdue instalment.

title: Early repayment
text: This loan agreement includes a prepayment penalty of 2% of the remaining principal.
expected: Cost of leaving or repaying early

title: Termination
text: The landlord may terminate at any time under this agreement.

title: Guarantee
text: A personal guarantee covers the borrower's obligations under this loan agreement.

title: Deposit
text: The deposit paid under this rental agreement will be forfeited for early departure.

title: Balloon
text: The borrower owes a balloon payment of $9000 at the end of the loan term.

title: No prepayment penalty
text: This loan agreement has no prepayment penalty.

title: No renewal
text: This lease does not automatically renew.

title: Ordinary payment
text: The tenant shall pay rent of $1000 on the first day of each month.

title: Unrelated text
text: The city library opens at nine and closes at six. Reading groups meet every Saturday.
